title: Conditional promises to the Gentiles
summary: The verses state conditional promises for Gentiles who hearken to the Lamb of God and do not harden their hearts against him.

explicit_facts.text: If the Gentiles hearken to the Lamb of God, he will manifest himself to them in word and power, taking away their stumbling blocks.
If they do not harden their hearts against the Lamb of God, they will be numbered among the seed of thy father and the house of Israel.
They will be blessed upon the promised land forever and no longer brought into captivity; the house of Israel will no longer be confounded.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Present the conditional promises as text or narration rather than visible events.
unspecified_visual_details: Background and visual design for the narration.

narration.text: And it shall come to pass,
if the Gentiles shall hearken unto the Lamb of God
he shall manifest himself unto them in word, and also in power
And harden not their hearts against the Lamb of God,
they shall be numbered among the house of Israel;
they shall be a blessed people upon the promised land forever;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These are conditional promises, not narrated visible events. The opening caption preserves the passage's prophetic framing without assigning its speech to an unsupported speaker.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the promised manifestation, removal of stumbling blocks, or blessings as events occurring now.
Do not invent an appearance for the Lamb of God or depict a specific promised land.

title: The pit and justice
summary: The passage teaches that the great pit dug for the destruction of men will be filled by those who dug it, and that this is according to the captivity of the devil and the justice of God upon those who work wickedness and abomination.

explicit_facts.text: The great and abominable church dug the great pit for the destruction of men; the pit will be filled by those who dug it, unto their utter destruction.
The destruction described is not the destruction of the soul, except for casting it into hell which hath no end.
This is according to the captivity of the devil and the justice of God upon those who work wickedness and abomination before him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A restrained, nonliteral visual treatment may suggest the teaching without depicting the pit being filled as a present event.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of people, the church, the devil, the pit, hell, and any setting.

narration.text: that great pit which hath been digged for the destruction of men
shall be filled by those who digged it, unto their utter destruction
according to the captivity of the devil, and also according to the justice of God

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The passage presents the pit in a teaching; it does not narrate a visible pit-filling event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage the pit being filled as a present-tense event.
Do not invent appearances for people, the church, the devil, the pit, or hell.

title: The angel’s warning

explicit_facts.text: The angel speaks to Nephi about the Gentiles, the covenants of the Lord unto the house of Israel, and the consequence for those who do not repent.
The angel warns that woe will come to the Gentiles if they harden their hearts against the Lamb of God.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi and the angel are present during the angel’s speech.
unspecified_visual_details: The angel’s appearance, clothing, and posture.
The exact setting.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The verse presents a teaching about a future work, not a visible event occurring here.
unspecified_visual_details: The work's visible form and setting.
